data.title: Unit 12: The solar system
The moons
data.caption: The Earth and the Moon
Phases of the Moonn
data.text: Earth has one natural satellite orbiting it.
The tides in Earth's oceans are caused by the Moon's gravitational pull.
The moon helps us in measuring the days of our calendar.
The moon takes 27.3 days to orbit the Earth. This gives us the sidereal month.
A lunar month is measured according to the time it takes the Moon to pass through a complete cycle of its phases.
It is also known as a synodic month.
A lunar month is of about 29.5 days.
